name: KICK BUDS
description:
About This Game

◆KICK BUDS Kicks Off!

It’s a 3v3v3 PvP soccer action game like you’ve never seen before!

Play solo or with friends.

All you need to do is move, jump, and shoot your way to the top!

◆Two standout modes

・ Soccer Royale

It’s 3v3v3—first team to score 5 goals wins!

3 teams scramble to score multiple balls into each other's nets.

Jump into Ranked Match and test your skills! Team up with friends and enjoy co-op play.

・ Party Royale

Every Buds for themselves in a battle royale with races, target practice, and more.

Win 3 rounds against 8 players to become the champion!

◆Score a highlight-reel play!

Size up the field and take your best shot with a kick, header, or lob.

Score an overhead kick and become a high-flying football hero!

◆Customize Your Character

Express yourself with your Buds avatar.

Show off your style on the field and steal the show!
short_desc: KICK BUDS is a 3v3v3 PvP soccer action game like you’ve never seen before! Simple controls allow you to jump right in. Team up with friends for co-op play.
